text:
Findings first. I would not approve this as-is.

| Severity | File:lines | Issue |
|---|---:|---|
| high | `README.md:103-105` | Documented `make demo` / `emovec all --tiny` cannot run from this checkout because `data/stories` is empty and extraction requires story files. |
| high | `emovec/cli.py:54-58` | `generate-stories` tries to read `data/stories/manifest.json` before generation, so a missing dataset cannot be bootstrapped. |
| high | `outputs/tiny/vectors/manifest.json:14-16` | Committed output claims 80 extracted stories, but the source story dataset is absent, making artifacts stale/unreproducible. |
| medium | `emovec/extract.py:99-111` | `load_vectors` does not validate manifest model/scale/layers/emotions against the current config, allowing stale vectors to be silently reused. |
| medium | `emovec/model.py:121-125` | `mean_activations` can divide by zero or crash for single-token/empty inputs because `effective_start` may equal sequence length. |
| medium | `emovec/vectors.py:37-40` | `emotion_vectors` produces NaNs if any configured emotion has zero examples instead of failing clearly. |
| medium | `emovec/vectors.py:66-70` | `pca_components` divides by total variance without handling zero-variance inputs. |
| medium | `emovec/stories.py:136-137` | HTTP story generation has no timeout, so a hung endpoint can block the command indefinitely. |
| medium | `pyproject.toml:10-16` | Runtime dependencies are unpinned open ranges with no lockfile, hurting reproducibility for a model pipeline. |
| medium | `requirements.txt:1-6` | Duplicate unpinned dependency list can drift from `pyproject.toml` and gives no reproducible install target. |
| medium | `emovec/__init__.py:8-15` | Package import mutates global process environment, which is surprising for library consumers. |
| low | `emovec.egg-info/SOURCES.txt:17-22` | Generated packaging metadata is committed into source, creating stale build artifacts. |
| low | `emovec/config.py:60-94` | Config values are cast but not range-validated, so invalid fractions/counts fail later in less obvious places. |

Overall quality score: **5/10**. The core math and hook code is reasonably organized and has targeted unit tests, but the project is not cleanly reproducible from source, has stale generated artifacts, and has several validation/edge-case gaps around the pipeline boundary.

Estimated rewrite/significant-change size: **280 lines**. Most of that is not a full rewrite; it is dataset bootstrap fixes, manifest/config validation, input guards, dependency hygiene, and tests for those cases.

Tests: `python -m pytest -q` did not collect because this environment lacks installed dependencies (`numpy`, `PyYAML`, etc.). I did not install the heavy ML stack during review.

issues.description: Documented demo command fails on a clean checkout because data/stories is empty and extraction requires files.
generate-stories reads data/stories/manifest.json before generation, so a missing dataset cannot be bootstrapped.
Committed extraction output claims 80 stories although the source story dataset is absent.
load_vectors does not validate saved manifest compatibility with the current config/model.
mean_activations can divide by zero or crash for single-token/empty inputs.
emotion_vectors silently produces NaNs when an emotion has no examples.
pca_components divides by zero for zero-variance activation matrices.
Story-generation HTTP calls have no timeout and can hang indefinitely.
Runtime dependencies are unpinned open ranges with no lockfile for reproducible installs.
Duplicate unpinned dependency list can drift from pyproject.toml.
Importing the package mutates global process environment variables.
Generated packaging metadata is committed as source and can go stale.
Config values are cast but not range-validated before pipeline execution.
